CHI.name: Tobe Awaka
CHI.detail: Awaka (back) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Nets.

CHI.name: Caleb Wilson
CHI.detail: Wilson (hand) is expected to miss four to six weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

DAL.name: Tobi Lawal
DAL.detail: Lawal is out for Wednesday's game against the Warriors due to tightness in his right groin.

DAL.name: Sergio de Larrea
DAL.detail: De Larrea (knee) is listed as out for Wednesday's game against the Warriors.

DAL.name: Dereck Lively II
DAL.detail: Lively (foot) is out for Wednesday's game against the Warriors.

DAL.name: Tarik Biberovic
DAL.detail: Biberovic (heel) is out for Wednesday's game against the Warriors.

DEN.name: Julian Strawther
DEN.detail: Strawther (knee) was diagnosed with a left knee sprain Friday and will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.

HOU.name: Alperen Sengun
HOU.detail: Sengun (eye) will not return to Wednesday's game against the Pacers, Will Guillory of The Athletic reports.

HOU.name: Clint Capela
HOU.detail: Capela (ankle) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against Indiana.

LAL.name: Austin Reaves
LAL.detail: Head coach JJ Redick said Reaves' (heel) pregame workout went "well," but he remains without an official timetable to return, Daniel Starkand of LakersNation.com reports.

MIA.name: Myron Gardner
MIA.detail: Gardner (hamstring) is out for Wednesday's game against the Bucks.

NO.name: Bennedict Mathurin
NO.detail: Mathurin (foot) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against Detroit.

NO.name: Bryce McGowens
NO.detail: McGowens (elbow) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against Detroit.

NO.name: Trendon Watford
NO.detail: Watford (ankle) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against Detroit.

NO.name: Trey Murphy III
NO.detail: Murphy (knee) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against Detroit.

NO.name: Dejounte Murray
NO.detail: Murray (ankle) is out for Friday's game against Memphis.

OKC.name: Alex Caruso
OKC.detail: Caruso won't return to Wednesday's game against the Hawks due to right hip soreness, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

OKC.name: Thomas Sorber
OKC.detail: Sorber underwent an arthroscopic knee procedure Tuesday to address inflammation at the patellofemoral joint in his right knee, and he's expected to return to on-court activities in 6-8 weeks, Steve McGehee of News 9 Oklahoma City reports.

OKC.name: Cason Wallace
OKC.detail: Wallace underwent surgery Friday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

OKC.name: Chet Holmgren
OKC.detail: Holmgren underwent a biological treatment Friday to address a small patellar tendon tear and will miss at least 8-10 weeks, Nick Crain of Slam reports.

OKC.name: Jalen Williams
OKC.detail: Williams (leg) underwent successful surgery Wednesday to "address a fractured left fibula and reconstruction of ankle ligaments following a fracture and dislocation." He will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Tim MacMahon of ESPN.com reports.

PHI.name: Tyrese Maxey
PHI.detail: Maxey (foot) is out for Wednesday's game in Orlando, Ky Carlin of USA Today reports.

PHI.name: Dean Wade
PHI.detail: Wade (hamstring) is out for Wednesday's game in Orlando.

PHI.name: Jaylen Brown
PHI.detail: Brown (hamstring) will be re-evaluated at some point this weekend, per Kris Rihm of ESPN.com.

PHI.name: Dominick Barlow
PHI.detail: Barlow (back) is out for Wednesday's game against Orlando.

PHI.name: Adem Bona
PHI.detail: Bona (back) will be re-evaluated in approximately one week after seeing a specialist, Ky Carlin of USA Today reports.

PHI.name: Ariel Hukporti
PHI.detail: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

PHX.name: Mark Williams
PHX.detail: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

SAC.name: Maxime Raynaud
SAC.detail: Raynaud (knee) will remain on the inactive list for Wednesday's game against the Suns.

SAC.name: Ben Simmons
SAC.detail: Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.

UTAH.name: Lauri Markkanen
UTAH.detail: Markkanen has been diagnosed with a non-displaced fracture in his right hand and will be sidelined for at least one month, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

UTAH.name: Jusuf Nurkic
UTAH.detail: Nurkic (toe) has begun participating in on-court activities as he continues recovering from a right foot injury sustained during an Oct. 4 preseason game against Denver. He will be re-evaluated in two weeks, the Jazz announced Friday.

UTAH.name: Jaren Jackson Jr.
UTAH.detail: Jackson has been diagnosed with a torn MCL in his right knee and will be sidelined for 6-to-8 weeks, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

WSH.name: Felix Okpara
WSH.detail: Okpara (illness) is available for Friday's game against Toronto.

WSH.name: Tristan Vukcevic
WSH.detail: Vukcevic (hip) has been ruled out for Monday's game against Memphis.

WSH.name: Reece Beekman
WSH.detail: The Wizards announced Monday that Beekman sustained a right acromioclavicular joint injury and will be re-evaluated in approximately three weeks.

WSH.name: Justin Champagnie
WSH.detail: Champagnie (foot) is expected to miss several months, per Josh Robbins of The Athletic.

WSH.name: Jamir Watkins
WSH.detail: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.
